children: A Jefferies-run fund said in court proceedings it has evidence of alleged fraudulent conduct by iron ore traders Radiant World and Sapphire Minmetals in receivables-financing deals with a face value of almost $900 million, according to Bloomberg.
The fund made the claim in court proceedings involving the transactions.

title: Jefferies Fund Says It Found Fraud in Nearly $900 Million Radiant Deals
